samples.message: Choose the lunar highland, set “Fit craters at least” to 30 km and leave the count as given. Read the index and the two ends of its 95 percent interval.
Choose the Martian highland (2), set “Fit craters at least” to 20 km and read the two ends of the interval of the index.
Choose the lunar mare (1), set “Fit craters at least” to 30 km and read the index and the upper end of its interval.
Choose the lunar highland (0), set “Fit craters at least” to 60 km and read the number of craters in the fit and the upper end of the interval.
Choose the lunar mare (1), set “Fit craters at least” to 30 km and read “Index, unbiased form”.
Choose the lunar highland (0), set “Fit craters at least” to 20 km and “A count that stops short” to 100 %, then read the index and the z in the slope check.
